ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black/dark grey) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blobs at the distal tips of both lobes, transitioning into a dense field of discrete white focal spots (mottling) concentrated along the central longitudinal axis and peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with a pixel angle of approximately 85 degrees and a depth relative to fluke height of approximately 1:6.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Moderate-frequency variations with pixel-amplitudes between 3-8 pixels detected along the trailing edge, most pronounced at the distal lobe tips and the interior edges leading into the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex curvature fitted to the leading edges, terminating in tapered, dorsally-swept distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of multiple circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (2-10 pixel diameter) distributed across the central dark pigment zone, consistent with previous barnacle colonization sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several unaligned, faint light-grey linear pixel disruptions oriented vertically/diagonally on the surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple circular white scars clustered on the right side of the peduncle; three distinct vertical rake-like linear marks on the mid-left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'stardust' pigmentation pattern consisting of high-density, sub-5-pixel white clusters against the dark primary field.
